title: First Nations Languages Funding Model
amount: Varies; eligible costs may be funded up to 100%
deadline_label: November 16, 2026, 4 p.m. ET
description: Funding for First Nations-led language revitalization, immersion, teaching and language plans, including multi-year projects.
eligibility: First Nations governments, institutions and eligible First Nations-led organizations or groups; stream-specific rules apply.
how_to_apply: Ontario applicants must use the First Nations Confederacy of Cultural Education Centres regional process; other regions may use Canadian Heritage.

title: Indigenous Transportation Initiatives Fund
amount: See current program guidelines
deadline_label: December 9, 2026, 5 p.m. EST
description: Transportation-related projects addressing Ontario's published 2027–28 priority themes.
eligibility: Ontario First Nation communities, Métis communities and Indigenous organizations.
how_to_apply: Apply through Ontario's official funding process and read the 2027–28 guidelines.

title: Indigenous Participation Fund — Consultation Supports
funder: Ontario Ministry of Energy and Mines
amount: Eligible staffing and consultation costs; see guidelines
deadline_label: Applications accepted on an ongoing basis
description: Build Indigenous consultation capacity in mineral exploration and mine development, including advisors and specialists.
eligibility: Ontario Indigenous communities with affected or potentially affected rights, and eligible representative organizations.
how_to_apply: Follow Ontario's application and program-guideline instructions for consultation supports.

title: Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund
amount: Project funding; refer to program stream
deadline_label: December 22, 2026, 4 p.m. EST
description: Support eligible community sport and recreation facilities and infrastructure.
eligibility: Indigenous communities are among eligible applicants; municipalities and non-profits can also apply.
how_to_apply: See Ontario's current funding page and the relevant application stream.

title: Ontario Public Library Operating Grants and First Nation Salary Supplement
funder: Ontario Ministry of Tourism, Culture and Gaming
amount: Operating, salary and digital-expense funding; amounts vary
deadline_label: November 19, 2026, 4 p.m. EST
description: Ontario public library operating grants, First Nation Salary Supplement and related digital-expense streams.
eligibility: Eligible First Nations public libraries and other public library service authorities; stream rules vary.
how_to_apply: One application through Transfer Payment Ontario can cover eligible streams.

title: Indigenous Forestry Initiative — Grant Funding
amount: Up to C$45,000 per project
deadline_label: September 1, 2028 (posted end date)
description: Support Indigenous forest stewardship, forest planning, policy participation and free, prior and informed consent activities.
eligibility: Indigenous communities and eligible Indigenous entities; detailed criteria are on the funder page.
how_to_apply: Follow the Indigenous Forestry Initiative applicant guide; verify remaining budget before investing in an application.

title: Creating, Knowing and Sharing — Short-Term Projects
amount: See portal for funding limits
deadline_label: Next listed deadline: November 25, 2026
description: Up to one year of artistic and cultural project activity for First Nations, Inuit and Métis creators.
eligibility: Eligible First Nations, Inuit and Métis individuals, groups and organizations.
how_to_apply: Register or sign in to the Canada Council client portal and read the opportunity requirements.

title: Creating, Knowing and Sharing — Travel
amount: See portal for funding limits
deadline_label: Apply any time before departure
description: Travel for Indigenous artists and arts organizations to advance research, markets, audiences or professional development.
eligibility: Eligible First Nations, Inuit and Métis individuals, groups and organizations.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Canada Council portal before the travel date.

title: Creating, Knowing and Sharing — Small-Scale Activities
amount: See portal for funding limits
deadline_label: Apply any time before activity starts
description: Support materials and artistic or professional development in Indigenous creative practice.
eligibility: Eligible First Nations, Inuit and Métis artists, groups and organizations.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Canada Council client portal before your proposed activity begins.

title: Building Brighter Futures — Bursaries and Scholarships
amount: Varies by award, study and assessed need
deadline_label: Next cycle deadline: February 1, 2027, 11:59 p.m. EST
description: Scholarships and bursaries for Indigenous learners; Indspire lists multiple deadlines during each academic cycle.
eligibility: First Nations, Inuit and Métis students meeting the relevant education and Indspire registration criteria.
how_to_apply: Review Indspire requirements, verify the current application cycle and apply directly via Indspire.

title: Ontario Indigenous Student Bursary
amount: Based on financial need and institution funding
deadline_label: Deadline set by each college, university or Indigenous Institute
description: Financial-need support for Indigenous students in eligible Ontario post-secondary or training programs.
eligibility: Self-identified Indigenous learners attending participating publicly assisted institutions or recognized Indigenous Institutes.
how_to_apply: Ask your institution's financial aid office or Indigenous student services for deadlines and applications.

title: Post-Secondary Student Support Program
funder: Indigenous Services Canada / First Nations administrators
amount: Partial or full assistance may be available; funding is limited
deadline_label: Deadline set by each First Nation or regional administrator
description: Support toward eligible post-secondary costs, administered locally by First Nations or designated organizations.
eligibility: Registered First Nations students enrolled in eligible studies and meeting administrator criteria.
how_to_apply: Contact your First Nation, designated administrator or Indigenous Services Canada regional office.

title: Post-Secondary Partnerships Program
amount: See regional program guidelines
deadline_label: Regional deadlines vary — contact office
description: Funding for First Nations post-secondary partnerships, education institutions and designated providers.
eligibility: Recognized First Nation band councils, band-designated organizations and First Nations-established institutions.
how_to_apply: Contact the Indigenous Services Canada regional office for application dates and process.

title: FedDev Ontario — Indigenous Business and Organization Support
amount: Varies; verify grant versus repayable terms
deadline_label: No fixed deadline; contact FedDev Ontario
description: Indigenous-led business growth, production, market development and skills-related projects in southern Ontario.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous businesses, economic development corporations and non-profit organizations in FedDev Ontario's service region.
how_to_apply: Contact the dedicated FedDev Ontario Indigenous team before preparing an application; not all funding is a grant.

title: New Relationship Fund
amount: See program team
deadline_label: Contact program team for intake availability
description: Build Indigenous consultation and engagement capacity for land and resource discussions.
eligibility: Indigenous communities and eligible Indigenous organizations; confirm stream criteria.
how_to_apply: Contact NewRelationshipFund@ontario.ca as directed on the official Ontario program page.

title: Creating, Knowing and Sharing — Indigenous Organizations
amount: Varies by application
deadline_label: Next listed deadline: Fall 2027
description: Multi-year funding for Indigenous arts organizations developing cultural and creative expression.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous not-for-profit and for-profit arts organizations.
how_to_apply: Monitor the Canada Council client portal for the Fall 2027 date; no precise date published on the program page.

title: Indigenous Economic Development Fund — Economic Diversification Grant
amount: Varies by stream
deadline_label: Last confirmed deadline: December 1, 2025
description: Supports Indigenous economic diversification and employment; the last published intake has closed.
eligibility: Eligibility varies for Indigenous entrepreneurs, communities and organizations.
how_to_apply: Monitor the official Ontario program for a new call; do not submit against the expired intake.

title: Indigenous Economic Development Fund — Regional Partnership Grant
amount: Varies by stream
deadline_label: Last confirmed deadline: December 1, 2025
description: Support Indigenous partnerships and regional economic development initiatives; the published intake is closed.
eligibility: Stream-specific eligible Indigenous organizations and communities.
how_to_apply: Monitor Ontario's official fund page for the next opening.

title: Indigenous Community Capital Grants Program
amount: Depends on feasibility, design or construction stage
deadline_label: Last confirmed deadline: November 20, 2025
description: Community feasibility, design, construction or renovation projects on and off reserve.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous community applicants meeting Ontario capital project rules.
how_to_apply: Wait for a newly published intake; check official guidelines before planning.

title: Indigenous Leadership Fund — First Nations and Designated Streams
amount: Amounts vary; First Nations stream cap up to C$6 million
deadline_label: Funder says First Nations and Designated streams are closed
description: Indigenous-led renewable energy, energy efficiency and low-carbon heating projects.
eligibility: Indigenous governments, organizations and eligible Indigenous-owned businesses; streams vary.
how_to_apply: Monitor the official program page for a new intake; its named streams currently reject new applications.

title: Walpole Island First Nation Post-Secondary Education Sponsorship
funder: Walpole Island First Nation Education Department
amount: Funding is limited and subject to priority ranking and annual approval
deadline_label: Fall/Winter applications: May 31; Spring/Summer applications: April 1 (each applicable study year)
description: Local Bkejwanong education support for post-secondary study; students must apply annually and approvals are not guaranteed.
eligibility: Eligible Walpole Island First Nation members; community residence and student progression affect priority under the Nation's policy.
how_to_apply: Apply through the official Walpole Island First Nation post-secondary portal and follow the department's supporting-document instructions; check the applicable study-year deadline.

title: First Nations Resource Development Scholarship (2026–27)
amount: Eligible direct program costs plus C$2,500 allowance for 2026–27, as assessed by the institution
deadline_label: Applications and supporting-document deadlines depend on the post-secondary institution
description: Supports eligible First Nations learners studying approved resource-development programs at participating Ontario colleges, universities or recognized Indigenous Institutes.
eligibility: Students attending eligible Ontario institutions, enrolled in approved resource-development programs and members of or connected to an Ontario First Nations community; institution-specific conditions apply.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's financial aid office about the program, eligible courses, application documents and dates; OSAP application is not required.

title: Indigenous Teacher Education — Retain+ 2026 Open Call
amount: Up to C$200,000 per project over 1–3 years; C$1 million call allocation
deadline_label: March 26, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
description: Supports projects to retain Indigenous teachers through mentorship, wellness, professional learning, language and culturally grounded teaching supports.
eligibility: Qualified First Nations, Inuit or Métis communities, post-secondary institutions, education organizations and eligible registered non-profits/charities. Returning 2024 Retain grantees are excluded under the funder's rules; confirm project leadership requirements.
how_to_apply: Read the foundation's 2026 Retain+ guidance and scoring matrix, then request access via the Apply Now portal from the original funder page.

title: Future Generations Foundation — Organization Funding
amount: Up to C$200,000/year for local or provincial projects; up to C$400,000/year for national projects, up to 5 years
deadline_label: Annual November–January call; November 2026 newsletter reports opening November 6, but confirm closing date in the portal
description: First Nations-focused grants for community-led language, cultural revitalization, healing, education and reconciliation initiatives.
eligibility: First Nations governments and eligible qualified donees, registered charities or non-Indigenous charities mandated to serve First Nations; check the funder's organization rules.
how_to_apply: Use the foundation's online portal when the 2026 organization call is confirmed open; check the current deadline and required budgets and documents directly.

title: Continuing Their Journey — Survivor and Community Projects
amount: Up to C$200,000 for a one-year project, subject to scope and fund availability
deadline_label: Year-round intake; several decision points; confirm the next review date with the funder
description: Supports First Nations communities and Survivor groups responding to the recovery or confirmation of unmarked graves and missing children at former residential school sites.
eligibility: Eligible First Nations communities and residential-school Survivor groups and related applicants, subject to the foundation's specific project and application requirements.
how_to_apply: Review Continuing Their Journey guidance and apply directly through the foundation's application portal; ask the funder about current review cycles.

title: Future Generations Foundation — Individual Funding
funding_type: Individual education, trades or cultural-learning funding
amount: Up to C$20,000 per year, subject to need and fund availability
deadline_label: 2026 individual call closed June 5, 2026; next call anticipated April 2027, exact deadline unannounced
description: Support for qualifying First Nations adults pursuing post-secondary education, trades training and approved cultural learning activities.
eligibility: First Nations members aged 18 or older by December 31, 2026, with membership/status and other program conditions; see original source.
how_to_apply: Monitor the foundation's next individual funding call and submit through its online portal; do not use the closed 2026 call.

title: Indigenous Screen Office — Production Program for All 2026
amount: Up to C$75,000 for eligible individuals/collectives/community groups; company caps up to C$750,000 by project budget/type
deadline_label: November 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time
description: Supports eligible Indigenous-led short films, features and screen/TV/web series in the production stage.
eligibility: First Nations, Inuit and Métis screen creators, eligible groups or Indigenous-owned production companies meeting ISO copyright, control and experience criteria.
how_to_apply: Read the 2026 program and ISO general funding guidelines, assemble project budget and rights documents, and apply through ISO's portal before 5 p.m. PST.

title: Indigenous Screen Office — Interactive and Immersive Program 2026
amount: ISO up to C$50,000 development or C$100,000 production; additional CMF amounts depend on separate eligibility
deadline_label: December 2, 2026, 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time
description: Supports Indigenous-controlled video games, augmented and virtual reality, apps and other audiovisual interactive projects.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous individuals, sole proprietors, collectives, companies and governing/community bodies with Indigenous creative control; CMF co-funding has additional conditions.
how_to_apply: Read the ISO/CMF program criteria and apply through the official ISO portal before its stated Pacific-time deadline.

title: Indigenous Screen Office — Finishing Fund
amount: Up to C$60,000 for features/TV series or C$25,000 for shorts/web/interactive work
deadline_label: Program page says temporarily closed despite nominal March 1, 2027 end date
description: Support for post-production work on eligible Indigenous screen productions; the detailed funder page currently says applications are temporarily closed.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous-owned production companies with a rough/fine cut, financial and creative control, and other ISO conditions; previous ISO funding usually expected.
how_to_apply: Do not apply while temporarily closed; check the detailed ISO fund page for reopening, despite the older/general funding list.

title: Indigenous Screen Office — Marketing, Promotion and Distribution 2026
amount: Up to C$50,000 for features and TV series or C$25,000 for shorts, web series and interactive projects
deadline_label: Rolling until funds run out or March 1, 2027, whichever comes first
description: Helps Indigenous-owned screen companies bring productions and interactive works to markets and audiences.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous-owned screen-based companies with qualifying film, series or immersive projects and ISO creative-control documentation.
how_to_apply: Review the 2026 program guidance and submit through ISO's portal while funds remain; verify that the portal still accepts applications.

title: Indigenous Screen Office — Travel Program 2026
amount: Up to C$2,500 Canada travel; C$3,500 US; C$4,500 international
deadline_label: Rolling until funds are depleted or March 1, 2027; apply at least 15 business days before travel
description: Supports Indigenous screen-based creatives attending project activities, festivals, markets, training and industry-development opportunities.
eligibility: Eligible Indigenous screen creators and representatives meeting ISO general funding, project-purpose and timely-application conditions.
how_to_apply: Submit an application through ISO's portal at least 15 business days before travel, subject to program budget remaining.

title: Canada Cultural Spaces Fund — Indigenous Heritage and Arts Spaces
amount: Typically up to 50% of eligible project costs; exceptions require approval and available funding
deadline_label: Continuous applications while limited funds remain; projects must meet March 31, 2028 completion conditions
description: Supports specialized equipment and certain renovations for arts/heritage spaces, including Indigenous cultural spaces; construction generally excluded except rare exceptions.
eligibility: Qualified non-profit arts/heritage organizations and Indigenous governing bodies or agencies with demonstrated arts/heritage activity; no individuals or for-profit applicants.
how_to_apply: Contact a Canadian Heritage regional advisor before applying, confirm funding and eligible expense timing, then submit the complete application to the regional office.

title: Toronto Arts Council — Indigenous Arts Projects
amount: Amount varies; refer to current Toronto Arts Council guidelines
deadline_label: Rolling application deadline; consult TAC for current application conditions
description: Grants for Indigenous artists, collectives and organizations to create, develop, present and advance Indigenous arts in Toronto.
eligibility: Indigenous artists, collectives and organizations with qualifying Toronto-based arts activity and TAC program eligibility; not a province-wide applicant fund.
how_to_apply: Review TAC's Indigenous Arts Projects guidelines and apply through its official TAC Grants Online portal.
